description: Read Google Business service areas (the towns and postcodes a location covers, up to 20). view=areas (default): the current business type, country, and place list for one location. view=places (q required): search for a town or postcode to add. Place IDs from view=places are regions, not the review-link Place ID. Town search needs a maps key on the server; if it is missing, add a place with its Place ID and name on the update instead.

account_id.description: Google Business account ID from list_accounts. Required for view=areas.

location_id.description: Google Business numeric location id (the location_id/platform_user_id from list_accounts, e.g. "197940849675145390"). NOT the ChIJ... Place ID from list_google_business_reviews view=review_link. Prefer account_id.

q.description: places: town or postcode to search for.

region_code.description: places: optional two-letter country code, for example GB.

workspace_id.description: Filter to a workspace ID from whoami.

name: list_google_business_service_areas
